title: Workshop sites disappearing
body: I've found it frustrating when workshop pages are deleted and disappear. Can we include in the template workflow an option/instructions on how to save your site with Internet Archive http://archive.org/web/?
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
> I've found it frustrating when workshop pages are deleted and disappear.

I know how frustrating this is but there is no way for us to enforce the pages to keep live. And with the new GDPR right to erasure/right to be forgotten it will be harder.

> Can we include in the template workflow an option/instructions on how to save your site with Internet Archive http://archive.org/web/?

Pull request are welcome but I don't think that a lot of people will use it.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: we're going to revisit how the workshop websites are set up in the near future and could revisit this, but for the time being I don't think there is much we can do on the template side of things.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
